reference.model: Separate public OpenMM Modeller + amber14-all.xml/amber14/tip3p.xml; neutral explicitly capped AlaValPro, cubic 0.35 nm padding, TIP3P, zero molar salt.

reference.quantization: Bundled TIP3P PDB stores 0.001 angstrom steps. A difference of two independently rounded 3D positions has vector error at most sqrt(3)*1e-4 nm; the corresponding two-vector angular bound is 2*asin(error/0.09572).
reference.scope: Contract/parity and bounded geometry receiving, not equilibrium, packing-quality, ion-count or universal force-field qualification.
